raw_hints: Footprint: rectangular roughly 7×5 blocks (top-down images show an off-center small protrusion on one side; main structure is centered).
Walls: start with a 1-block-high stonebrick foundation, build corner pillars up 4 blocks, fill center with brick blocks and place wooden plank strips across horizontally between pillar heights.
Roof: place 5 progressively smaller layers of stone slabs centered on top to create a stepped taper; each tier overhangs slightly as seen.
Entrance: central recessed 1-block-wide doorway with a smooth block (probably quartz or stone) as threshold; place slab awnings above windows (stone slabs) at mid-height.
rebuild_intent.summary: Small rectangular single-story structure with layered stepped slab roof centered over a narrow footprint. Walls have alternating horizontal bands: bottom stonebrick base, mid brick panels, wooden plank trim and stone corner pillars. A centered recessed entrance with a single smooth block step. Roof is a series of stacked stone slabs forming a tapered stepped top. Building sits inside a shallow dug plot.
